messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: genqueue-east latency spike > 95th pct (P1). Triggered at 2024-08-15T02:34:38Z. Bridge: <https://meet.redwood/incident-6312345678|incident-6312345678>.

alice-sre: I’m on the bridge. initial hypothesis: regional routing overloaded after recent autoscale hiccup.

ben-ops: putting together a quick impact statement for statuspage. thinking: "Partial degradation in text generation in US-East, retries may succeed; fallbacks to other regions active." thoughts? :thinking_face:

carol-support: customers on EU and APAC reporting OK. only a handful of US customers with elevated latency. we should mark as partial degradation, not outage.

eric-eng: confirmed autoscaler failed to add nodes due to quota error. manual scale while we fix quota.

alice-sre: good call. can someone draft initial statuspage copy? short, clear, include affected service, regions, mitigation, ETA.

ben-ops: draft below, please review/trim.

```
Initial status update (draft):
- Impact: Partial degradation for text generation in US-East region. Some requests experiencing high latency or timeouts.
- Scope: A subset of customers routed to US-East; other regions not affected.
- Mitigation: Engineers scaling capacity and routing some traffic to US-West/EU as fallback.
- ETA: Monitoring; next update in 15 minutes.
```

alice-sre: :eyes: tweak: add note about no data loss and we have fallbacks.

ben-ops: updated draft:

```
Initial status update (v2):
- Impact: Partial degradation for text generation in US-East. Some requests may see elevated latency or timeouts. No data loss.
- Scope: Affected subset of customers routed to US-East; other regions operating normally.
- Mitigation: Manual scale in progress; traffic being rerouted to US-West/EU where possible.
- Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have new info.
```

carol-support: lgtm. can legal review short wording for customer-facing? @fiona-legal

fiona-legal: quick scan: fine. avoid promising ETA; recommend "expected next update" phrasing. replace ETA line accordingly.

ben-ops: applied legal feedback, final draft below. ready to publish once on-call / SRE approves.

```
Statuspage update (publish):
- Impact: Partial degradation for text generation in US-East. Some requests may experience elevated latency or timeouts. No data loss is expected.
- Scope: Affected subset of requests routed to the US-East region. Other regions (US-West, EU) operating normally.
- Mitigation: Engineers are performing a manual scale while we remediate autoscaling. Traffic is being routed to alternate regions where possible.
- Next update: We will provide another update in ~15 minutes or as the situation evolves.
```

alice-sre: publishing now. @ben-ops can you post the statuspage update and ping customers via outbound channel?

ben-ops: publishing... <https://status.redwood/incident/6312345678|status.redwood/incident/6312345678> :white_check_mark:

carol-support: sending outbound note to affected customers with guidance to retry or use region hints. short message drafted: "We’re seeing increased latency in US-East; we recommend routing to other regions where possible. Our engineers are on it."

eric-eng: manual scale complete, node count back to expected. autoscaler logs show quota error cleared. rolling traffic back with ramp.

alice-sre: monitoring KV cache and genqueue tail. initial error rate dropping.

carol-support: confirmation from a few affected customers: latency improving.

ben-ops: drafting follow-up status update (15m):

```
Update: Mitigation in progress. Manual scaling completed and traffic is being gradually routed back to US-East. Error rate and latency are decreasing. We will continue to monitor and provide another update in 15 minutes or when we reach normal levels.
```

fiona-legal: good to include that we’ll notify customers if any have escalated SLAs impacted.

alice-sre: agree. added SLA line to follow-up.

ben-ops: publishing update... :rocket:

incident-bot: Statuspage update posted: <https://status.redwood/incident/6312345678|Incident 6312345678> (update 2).

alice-sre: observe for 10 mins then if stable prepare resolved message.

eric-eng: metrics show return to baseline for latency and error rate.

carol-support: customers confirming resolution.

ben-ops: draft resolved notice below for review:

```
Resolved: The partial degradation of text generation in US-East has been resolved. Manual scaling restored capacity; autoscaling quota issue cleared. No data loss occurred. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.
```

alice-sre: :thumbsup: publish resolved. thanks all.

ben-ops: published resolved notice and closed incident. <https://status.redwood/incident/6312345678|link>. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 6312345678 marked resolved at 2024-08-15T02:48:40Z.

carol-support: leaving a short postmortem stub for the incident in #postmortems and assigning to alice-sre + eric-eng.

alice-sre: will own follow-up: autoscaler quota checks and improved alerting to avoid manual scale.

ben-ops: thanks everyone. short retro q for oncall handoff notes: did we miss any customer segments? nothing flagged. closing thread. :folded_hands:
